# Search inventory names

**Blocked by:** merge of planning-document PR #12

Return matching inventory records in input order using the [accepted specification](https://github.com/example/inventory/issues/10). Empty query returns all records; no matches and empty input return an empty list. Existing empty_message and stock_total behavior is unchanged.
